body_markdown:
*Fundraise Insider tracks newly funded startups each week and delivers verified[sales leads](https://fundraiseinsider.com/) of C-suite contacts straight to your inbox, so you reach the right people while the funding is still fresh.[See pricing.](https://fundraiseinsider.com/pricing)*


MORE has raised $4.4 million according to a recent SEC filing. The filing puts the total offering at $5 million and lists 38 investors in this close, which makes the[Seed round](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/seed-startups/) a partially completed raise rather than a finished one.


The company develops and distributes new technologies meant to improve[sports](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/recently-funded-sports-startups/) and entertainment events and the experiences around them.


Joe Markowski and Jeremy Simmonds founded the business in 2025. It operates from Brooklyn, New York.


Vendors and agencies that want to reach newly funded companies while the money is still being allocated can start with the[B2B Sales Leads List](https://fundraiseinsider.com/outsourced-b2b-lead-generation/) .
